title: Heavy, nice  Not cuddly.
text:
Heavy, nice Not cuddly.. Nice heavy throw, well made, but not soft And cuddly. I did wash it, and put it in the dryer with a dryer sheet .
It shrunk a bit.
The colors are the new gray, and a little off white print, that looks good.

I have it draped over a gray chair, and it looks nice.

3 star
